decisions.decision: Keep Ripple's $16T 2025 transaction figure and $900M annualized revenue run rate as company-reported ecosystem metrics, not XRP-specific activity.
Classify RLUSD as a company-reported stablecoin facilitating onchain repo markets; do not label XRP as Ripple Prime collateral without a source.
required_verification: haircuts, financing balances, repo market volumes

decisions.decision: Treat BNY/C2FO supplier finance and Ripple Treasury tokenized money-market funds as XRPL institutional adoption signals, not proof of XRP demand.
Include policy rate, SOFR and Treasury curve as candidate exogenous features, but do not infer a directional XRP signal from one observation.
required_verification: real yields, DXY, credit spreads, global liquidity

decisions.decision: Do not issue an XRP probability from the new corporate and macro announcements.
decisions.reason: no calibrated model or synchronized point-in-time feature history
